scope: Evasive skill taxonomy corrections and cast-only coverage

records.name: Force Shield
records.effect: Extendable blue barrier that cancels Ki waves and knocks back nearby opponents.

records.name: Science Vanish
records.effect: Towa disappears and can move while invisible before reappearing.

records.name: Celestial Wave
records.character_source: Goku (Ultra Instinct -Sign-); Goku (Ultra Instinct) Turtle Hermit Gi 3
records.effect: Seven-hit blue energy wave launched into the air.

records.name: Mighty Explosive Wave
records.effect: Evasive variant of the explosive-wave technique used by Jiren (Full Power).

notes: This batch distinguishes skill variants by canonical class: Mighty Explosive Wave has both a Super Skill form and a separate Jiren (Full Power) Evasive variant. Force Shield and Celestial Wave use their dedicated pages' explicit Ki Blast Evasive classification. Science Vanish is explicitly Other Evasive and unavailable to CaCs.
